page.overview:
Who is Daz Bonez?

"The Killer" Daz Bonez, alias Mr. 1, is a former bounty hunter and the former highest-ranked male Officer Agent of Baroque Works. His partner was Miss Doublefinger. After escaping Impel Down, he traveled with Crocodile in the New World and later joined Crocodile's new organization, Cross Guild.

He was a major antagonist during the Arabasta Arc and a tentative ally in the Impel Down and Marineford Arcs.

Daz is a tan man with long, thin limbs and fingers. He is tall and very muscular and his head is shaven. His most striking feature is probably the black , right over his round eyes. He has big lips and the archaic Japanese symbol of the number tattooed on his torso.

In the Arabasta Kingdom, he sported an oriental-looking attire consisting of a sleeveless dark coat with golden edges and white motifs on the front, over very loose beige pants held up by a white sash around the waist, with some light brown fur sprouting from it. His pants were tucked inside some bandages wrapped around his calves and in part around his shoes.
